verdict.rationale: A probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document served at HTTP 200 from Cloudflare's developer docs domain (developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json), which also hosts the AI Gateway docs. However, it is a Cloudflare-wide spec, and nothing in the pack shows it covers AI Gateway's endpoints. missing for 10: evidence that the spec covers AI Gateway endpoints (e.g. /chat/completions, gateway config, logs), first-party docs pointing to a downloadable AI Gateway spec, hands-on corroboration of its completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
